source_snapshot.criteria: Policy matches; post-AC host state equals the state immediately before loss.

historical_reviews.deepseek: It identifies the LastState setting but does not prove BMC-reset persistence or either physical transition and lacks exact sampling, safe outage and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly makes the immediate pre-loss state the oracle and requires two separately observed trials.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: LastState is temporal: the comparison point is the actual chassis state immediately before AC removal, not an earlier command or desired state. Evidence must therefore bind a timestamped pre-cut observation to the same outlet's restore event and resulting host state.

original_test_intent: Validate supported LastState/previous policy persistence and demonstrate that AC restoration returns the host to its immediately preceding on or off state.
original_method: Preserve the original policy/workload baseline, set LastState through a supported protected path, verify before and after BMC reset, then with human control capture the exact on state immediately before one AC loss/return and the exact off state before a separate trial; compare each final state, verify health and restore baseline.
manual_activity: An operator approves policy/reset/outage actions, attests the state immediately before each AC cut, performs the physical action and owns recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Supported previous/LastState mapping and sampling semantics
On/off pre-cut and post-restore acceptance matrix
safety_requirements: Approve policy, reset and each AC action separately
Use protected secrets and supported interfaces
Stop on mismatched state, wrong target, alarm or timeout
Restore original policy/workload and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Prepare and timestamp two pre-cut state ledgers

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The previous-policy set/readback is relevant supporting work, but inline credentials and absence of BMC-reset, pre-cut state and physical restore evidence make it insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected supported set/readback, then pair each operator-controlled AC edge with an immediate independent pre-cut observation and bounded post-return state/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/40-minute estimates, controller reset and both source scenarios are retained; log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each on/off trial, record policy, chassis state, outlet telemetry and observer timestamp directly before AC loss, followed by AC return, BMC readiness, host final state and health, then restore the original policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the sampling point and proof chain needed to distinguish LastState from AlwaysOn/Off.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A setting string cannot prove which state firmware sampled or whether that state was honored after full power loss.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Soft-off, graceful shutdown and abrupt loss can be sampled differently by firmware; the Project must select the intended state transition.

project_override_considerations: The Project must specify when LastState is sampled and whether soft-off is the required off state. No policy or AC action may run without outlet binding, outage approval and recovery.
expected_evidence: Approved target, LastState semantics, baseline policy/workload and recovery
Protected set/readback before and after BMC reset
Immediate on-pre-cut observation and matching on result after AC return
Immediate off-pre-cut observation and matching off result
Original policy/workload restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently specify LastState/previous behavior for both pre-loss states; missing sampling detail is a project input, not a conflicting Master branch.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sampling semantics, controlled outlet, outage approval, backup and recovery are normal prerequisites; execution blocks only when these cannot be established safely.

review_improvement: Makes LastState evidence temporally traceable and prevents set/readback from substituting for both required physical state transitions.
independent_technical_reasoning: A LastState controller may sample at soft shutdown, power-good loss or another vendor-defined transition. Without a timestamped observation immediately before the approved AC cut, a later matching state can be coincidental. Two opposite starting states on the same mapped outlet create the minimal discriminating matrix while retaining safe recovery controls.
